MANDRAKE SALON: ROPES & BEYOND

The Mandrake Hotel, CoOc Members Club

Thursday 26th November
Discover the sensual art of rope through restraint, movement, trust and connection. Back by popular demand, Ropes & Beyond returns to The Mandrake Salon for an intimate exploration of rope as a way to build connection, trust and sensuality. Led by Sophie Cohen and held in our member’s club COOC, the session will introduce creative ways to work with rope, from the foundations of trust and safety to techniques that use movement, breath and full-body sensory experiences to deepen connection.
